00053 void WhiteNoiseUGenInternal::processBlock(bool& shouldDelete, const unsigned int blockID, const int channel) throw()
00054 {
00055     int numSamplesToProcess = uGenOutput.getBlockSize();
00056     float* outputSamples = uGenOutput.getSampleData();
00057     
00058     unsigned long s1, s2, s3;
00059     random.get(s1, s2, s3);
00060         
00061     while(numSamplesToProcess--)
00062     {
00063         *outputSamples++ = Ran088::nextBiFloat(s1, s2, s3);
00064     }
00065     
00066     random.set(s1, s2, s3);
00067 }
